title: Probability in a box sloshing at (E₂ − E₁)/h
caption: For (φ₁ + φ₂)/√2 in a box, each stationary state alone has a time-independent |ψ|², but the mixture does not: at x = L/4 the density is (2/L)[0.75 + 0.71 cos(2π(E₂ − E₁)t/h)]. Since E₂ − E₁ = 3E₁ the density oscillates at f = 3E₁/h, three full cycles in each time h/E₁.
alt: Graph of probability density at one point against time in units of h over E1 from 0 to 1: a cosine with three full cycles, varying between 1.46 and 0.04.
description: The horizontal axis is time in units of h/E₁; the vertical axis is |ψ|² at x = L/4 in units of 2/L.
At x = L/4, φ₁² = 0.5 and φ₂² = 1 (in units of 2/L) and the cross term is 2φ₁φ₂ × ½ cos ωt: |ψ|² = 0.75 + 0.71 cos ωt.
The two components have energies E₁ and E₂ = 4E₁, so ω = (E₂ − E₁)/ħ = 3E₁/ħ and f = 3E₁/h.
Three complete cycles fit into one unit of h/E₁.

checks.name: the density starts at its maximum 0.75 + 0.71
half a period later (t = h/6E₁) it is at its minimum
